svg.title: Replace and Augment: two deployment patterns behind the same FHIR boundary
svg.desc: A side-by-side comparison of two Cloud Health Office deployment patterns. Both present the same FHIR and Da Vinci boundary to external callers — patient apps, provider systems and other payers. In Replace mode, requests pass from the FHIR and Da Vinci boundary into Cloud Health Office, which serves them from its own native authorization, member, claims and consent capabilities; Cloud Health Office is the authoritative system of record, and this is the mode the acceptance suite proves. In Augment mode, requests pass from the same boundary into Cloud Health Office, which acts as the interoperability and API layer in front of an existing core administration platform such as QNXT, Facets or HealthEdge through a per-engagement adapter; the external core remains authoritative. The diagram notes that the external-core adapters in this repository are documented stubs, so Augment scenarios are scored separately as integration capability and appear as tracked gaps rather than as product capability.
